Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway) is a renowned author who seeks help in the film Verity. (Supplied: Amazon MGM Studios)

Hollywood loves a Colleen Hoover adaptation.

The latest is psychological thriller Verity.

In the film, struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson) is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford (Oscar winner Anne Hathaway).

It starts out as an assignment taken under mysterious circumstances, with Lowen recruited by Verity's husband, Jeremy (Josh Hartnett).

Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson) is a struggling author hired as a ghostwriter. (Supplied: Amazon MGM Studios)
